description: This file provides a logging utility class that mimics Android's Log class, allowing for customizable logging nodes and levels. It wraps around android.util.Log and manages log node chaining.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class for centralized logging, managing log levels, log nodes, and providing static methods for various log priorities.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode data will be sent to.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Delegates log messages to the current LogNode, if set.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE priority.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG priority.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO priority.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN priority.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR priority.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT priority.
